input.summary: Built the grand stair in the central hall (x45..46, z60→54, y4→10, bricks core, landing at z53) and closed the upper hall floor around it with a rail. Added the carriage-house loft ladder at x90 z52. From a hall start, every house room on both floors is reached.
left: From the real entrance (47,1,31) every room reads UNREACHABLE until the front steps, gallery floor and front door exist. I checked with a temporary entrance inside the hall (47,4,45): all house rooms were ok.
Not reached yet, because their floors aren't built: the upper porch, ground gallery, rear porch, carriage loft, cottage rooms and gazebo.
The carriage-house loft floor (y6) must leave the cell x90 z52 open for the ladder, which runs y1..7 on the z53 wall. The ladder has no wall behind it until the carriage house is built.
The 'hallway to nowhere' lines from `mcd fit` are a side effect of the missing front door, not of the stairs.

I did not tick plan.md or elements.md and did not render stairs.png (out of time). My `sed` on plan.md failed, so no checklist edit was made. The note about the stair and ladder was appended to plan.md, but I did not confirm it landed.
